P.name: Living Forge
P.title: Template:Data Ornn/Living Forge
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Living Forge|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Ornn |skill = I |icon = Living Forge.png |description = {{sbc|Innate - Living Forge:}} '''Ornn''' can purchase [[item]]s from the [[shop]] even while outside of its range and from anywhere on the battlefield, by ''forging'' them. He is able to forge any non-[[consumable item|consumable]] item, and is also presented a ''Forge Menu'' to quickly forge his recommended items. Once '''Ornn''' attempts to purchase an item, he starts forging it, causing him to {{tip|channel}} for 4 seconds. Upon completion of the channel, he builds the item and pays its {{g|gold}} cost. The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} if '''Ornn''' takes damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}. ''Living Forge'' is disabled for 4 seconds after starting the channel. |description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Master Craftsman:}} '''Ornn''' uses his craftsmanship in forgery to upgrade {{tt|most|See notes}} [[Legendary item]]s that he and his teammates own into {{sbc|Masterwork}} items, increasing the [[Gold efficiency (League of Legends)|gold value]] of all {{tt|upgradeable stats|See notes}} on the item by exactly {{g|1000}}, shared equally among them. When '''Ornn''' reaches [[Experience (champion)|level]] 13, the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in his inventory is upgraded automatically. For each level after 13 and before 18 (levels 14–17, total of 4, once per ally per game), '''Ornn''' can upgrade the first eligible [[Legendary item]] in an allied champion's inventory into its {{sbc|Masterwork}} variant. He can do so by selecting the ally while within 600 range, and forges the item's upgrade by performing ''Living Forge's'' {{tip|channel}}.

Additionally, '''Ornn''' increases his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}} by 10% from all sources, further increased by 4% each time he upgrades a ''Legendary'' item into a {{sbc|Masterwork}} item, for a total increase of 30% to each stat after the maximum of 5 upgrades. |icon3 = Brittle icon.png |description3 = {{sbc|Innate - Temper:}} '''Ornn''' applies {{tip|Brittle}} to enemies hit by ''{{ai|Bellows Breath|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}''. His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against enemies afflicted with ''Brittle'' are empowered to {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} a short distance over {{tt|{{fd|0.4}} seconds|Estimated}}. '''Ornn's''' and allies' {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effects or {{tip|silence|silences}} against ''Brittle'' enemies will consume the debuff to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pp|key=%|type='''Ornn's''' level|9 + (17-9)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pp|type=[[File:Bellows Breath.png|20px|border]] ''Bellows Breath's'' rank|200 to 500 for 6|0 to 5|formula=200 + 60 per rank of ''Bellows Breath''}} against {{tip|monsters}}, and cause the crowd control to last 30% longer (if applicable). |description4 = '''''Ornn''' will prioritize upgrading the first Legendary item eligible for a {{sbc|Masterwork}} upgrade based on its position in the inventory, detecting each slot until an eligible item is found.'' |customlabel = {{tt|Forge Disable Time|Unaffected by ability haste}} |custominfo = {{tt|4|Cooldown begins on channel start}} |targeting = Passive |parry = true |affects = Allies |damagetype = Magic |spelleffects = Proc |spellshield = true |silence = true |notes = * '''Ornn's''' ''Forge Menu'' is a special menu in the HUD which has 5 slots. The player can quickly forge one of the recommended items by {{LMB}} clicking on its portrait or via the Champion Specific Interaction [[hotkey]]s (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F1–F5}}). * The item that '''Ornn''' upgrades for the ally is decided at the start of the forge channel. ** If the ally moves the item into a different slot during the channel, it will still be the item that gets upgraded. * {{sbc|Masterwork}} items inherit all properties of their pre-upgrade version, including the cooldowns of their [[Named item effect|effects]]. Internally, they are handled through an item modifier. An upgraded item gains the ('''{{as|Masterwork|buzzword3}}''') descriptor next to its name in tooltips as well as a special Masterwork frame overlay on the item's icon itself, both indicating the application of ''Living Forge's'' modifier. * Statistics' gold value and eligible stats to be increased for {{sbc|Masterwork}} items: ** {{g|31.25}} per 1 point of {{as|ability haste}}. ** {{g|20}} per 1 point of {{as|ability power}}. ** {{g|35}} per 1 point of {{as|attack damage}}. ** {{g|30}} per 1% of {{as|attack speed}}. ** {{g|20}} per 1 point of {{as|armor}}. ** {{g|18}} per 1 point of {{as|magic resistance}}. ** 1 point of {{as|health}} has a variable {{g|gold value}}, based on the number of upgradeable stats that exist on the item: **# If health is the item's only upgradeable stat, it receives +375 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|6}}}} per point. **# If the item has health and only one other upgradeable stat, it receives +185 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|702}}}} per point. **# If the item has health and two other upgradeable stats, it receives +125 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|6}}}} per point. **# If the item has health and three other upgradeable stats, it receives +90 health and health is valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|7}}}} per point. ** While not currently possible, if an item has no upgradeable stats, {{g|1000}} worth of health (valued at {{g|2.{{recurring|6}}}} per point) is added to the item.[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/1d2g5g8/why_does_edge_of_finality_only_give_525_gold/l64is3z/?context=3 GalaxySmash on if an item has no upgradeable stats] * The {{sbc|Masterwork}} stat increases are rounded down (any decimal values are lost). * ''Living Forge's'' bonus {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}} increase {{tip|stacks additively}} with {{iis|Jak'Sho, The Protean}} {{nie|Voidborn Resilience}} and {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|multiplicatively}} with {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}}. * Health and mana items built on the field will retain '''Ornn's''' previous {{as|health}} and {{as|mana}} percentage. Returning to base still brings health and mana back to full. * '''Ornn's''' basic attacks against {{tip|Brittle}} enemies will end the duration of the debuff {{tip|on-hit}} prematurely even if the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} was not applied. This does not trigger the consumed effect that deals the bonus damage, unless the target was an epic {{tip|monster}}. * {{tip|Brittle|Brittle's}} {{tip|Tenacity}} reduction will benefit all applicable types of {{tip|crowd control}}, not just {{tip|immobilize|immobilizes}} and {{tip|silence|silences}}. The following do not consume ''Brittle'' but benefit from the reduction: {{tip|blind|blinds}}, {{tip|cripple|cripples}}, {{tip|disarm|disarms}}, {{tip|ground|grounds}}, and {{tip|slow|slows}}. * {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both the knock back and the bonus damage from '''Ornn's''' empowered {{tip|brittle}} attack. * The {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} inflicted by ''Brittle'' is credited to '''Ornn''', and benefits from his {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}. * The {{sbc|Masterwork}} item upgrade on an ally will fail if the ally was channeling the [[File:Rift Herald Rodeo buff.png|20px|link=Rift Herald]] ''[[Rift_Herald#Abilities_2|Rift Herald Rodeo]]'' at the time of the forge's completion.{{bug}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Ornn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}: ** All of '''Ornn's''' actions are disabled during the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the channel. {{ct|channel|attack=interrupts|cast=interrupts|move=interrupts|items=interrupts,,, false|consume=interrupts|spells=interrupts|interrupts=death, silence|damage=true}} |tips = * Although {{tip|airborne}} effects won't be extended by {{tip|Brittle}}, if the spell simultaneously {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target, this stun will be extended and persist past the airborne duration, for an overall increased crowd control duration. ** ''{{cai|Searing Charge|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}'' each apply both airborne and stun simultaneously for the same duration for this reason. |yvideo = r_zd69jpEyo |flavorsound = {{sm2|Ornn Original P allypurchasesitem 11.ogg}} ''"The weapons I forge do not have names. They have ambitions."''
{{sm2|Ornn Original Passive SFX 0.ogg}} ''Masterwork item alert.'' |blurb = {{sbc|Innate - Living Forge:}} {{ci|Ornn}} can {{g|purchase}} items from anywhere by {{tip|channel|channeling}} for a few seconds. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Innate - Master Craftsman:}} From level 13 onward, '''Ornn''' can upgrade items he and his teammates own into Masterwork items, improving their stats. '''Ornn''' gains increased {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} from all sources, further increased each time he upgrades an item. |blurb3 = {{sbc|Innate - Temper:}} '''Ornn's''' basic attacks against {{tip|Brittle}} targets {{tip|airborne|knock them back}}. {{tip|immobilize|Immobilizing}} effects against Brittle targets will consume the debuff to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|'''target's''' maximum health}}. }}

Q.name: Volcanic Rupture
Q.title: Template:Data Ornn/Volcanic Rupture
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Volcanic Rupture|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ornn
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Volcanic Rupture.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ornn}} sends a fissure in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies hit for a short time.
|blurb2      = The fissure stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or max range, erupting a pillar of [[terrain]] that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies and lingers for a few seconds.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sends a fissure in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 40% for 2 seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 120}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}}}}
|description2 =  The fissure stops at maximum range or 200 units behind the first enemy champion struck. After a {{fd|1.125}}-second delay, a magma pillar then erupts at the location to {{tip|airborne|knock aside}} enemies, though not through terrain, and linger as impassible terrain for 4 seconds.
|description3 = ''The pillar will not expire during {{ais|Searing Charge|Ornn}} dash.''
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 750
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 130
|speed        = 1800
|cost         = 45
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|9|8.5|8|7.5|7}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|spellshield  = special
|projectile   = true
|notes        = 
* The fissure will move an 200 units beyond the first champion it hits, not exceeding the maximum range of the ability. ''It can still damage additional targets.''
* If launched in a wall, pillar will try to appear on the other side of the wall, if it cannot the pillar will be destroyed.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent the {{tip|airborne|knock aside}} from the magma pillar forming.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
|yvideo       = 6wwMmSHnjhE
}}

E.name: Searing Charge
E.title: Template:Data Ornn/Searing Charge
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Searing Charge|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Ornn
|skill        = E
|icon         = Searing Charge.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ornn}} charges in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through.
|blurb2      = '''Ornn''' will stop upon hitting terrain, creating a shockwave that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stuns}} them. This will also destruct his ''{{ai|Volcanic Rupture|Ornn}}'' and enemy-created [[terrain]].
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|charges}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through and stopping upon colliding with terrain.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|80|125|170|215|260}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' armor)}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
|description2 = If '''Ornn''' collides with terrain during the charge, he creates a shockwave that {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} and {{tip|stuns}} nearby enemies for {{fd|1.25}} seconds and deals the same damage if they were not already hit by the charge.
|description3 = The shockwave destroys the pillar formed by ''{{ai|Volcanic Rupture|Ornn}}'' and partially destroys [[terrain]] created by enemy {{tip|champions}}.
|description4 = '''''Ornn''' is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the dash ends.''
|target range = {{dv|800|{{tt|650|Dash distance}}}}
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|360|Shockwave radius}}|{{tt|150|Terrain collision range}}}}
|speed        = 1600
|cost         = {{ap|35 to 55}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cooldown     = {{ap|14 to 12}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.35}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|spellshield  = True
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = True
|notes        = 
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} may only block one instance of damage.
* The area in which enemies will be knocked up is indicated at '''Ornn''''s impact location.
** The indicator is not shown for [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* {{tip|Brittle}} enemies without {{tip|Tenacity}} of their own will be {{tip|stun|stunned}} for a total of {{fd|1.625}} seconds.
* ''Searing Charge'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* '''Ornn''' will not {{tip|dash}} after the cast time if he is {{tip|airborne}} or {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}}.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Ornn''' is in cast time and dashing:
** The lockout lingers briefly after the dash ends.
{{ct|cast|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false}}
|yvideo       = LYzNBoBmQ5c
}}

R.title: Template:Data Ornn/Call of the Forge God
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Call of the Forge God|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Ornn |skill = R |icon = Call of the Forge God.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Ornn}} summons a lava elemental that stampedes toward him, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit for a short time.

''Call of the Forge God'' can be recast while the elemental is active. |blurb2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction. If he hits the elemental, he sends it stampeding in the new direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for a brief time. |blurb3 = Each pass applies {{tip|Brittle}} to enemies hit for a short time. |blurb4 = {{sbc|{{tip|Brittle|nolink=true}}:}} The target loses {{sti|tenacity}}, increasing the duration of incoming {{tip|crowd control}}. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ornn''' sounds his horn, summoning a lava elemental at maximum range from the target direction that stampedes towards his casting position at increasing speed. The elemental deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds. |leveling = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|125|175|225}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}} {{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}} |description2 = ''Call of the Forge God'' can be recast after {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Includes the cast time}} seconds while the elemental is active. |icon3 = Call of the Forge God 2.png |description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Ornn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain.
